title: 家庭伦理与情感
desc: 孝道陪伴、代际沟通、家风与过度保护的高分表达，适用于亲情类作文论证与呼吁段。

entries.example: Filial piety has been a cornerstone of Chinese ethics for thousands of years.
entries.exampleZh: 孝道数千年来一直是中国伦理的基石。
entries.note: 不可数；比 love one's parents 正式得多，常与 uphold, practise 搭配。

entries.example: Young people away from home should still show filial respect to their elders.
entries.exampleZh: 离家的年轻人仍应对长辈尽孝。
entries.note: 介词 to 不可省略；respect 此处不可数，适合表达态度类句子。

entries.en: take care of one's aging parents
entries.example: Grown children should take care of their aging parents rather than hire caregivers.
entries.exampleZh: 成年子女应当照顾年迈的父母，而不是雇人代劳。
entries.note: aging 亦可写作 ageing；常与 shoulder the duty 连用加重语气。

entries.example: Nothing can replace the comfort of accompanying one's parents on ordinary days.
entries.exampleZh: 没有什么能替代在平常日子里陪伴父母的温暖。
entries.note: accompany sb 后不接 with；名词 company 表陪伴，如 keep sb company，适合陪伴类论证。

entries.example: Busy professionals should spend quality time with their families at weekends.
entries.exampleZh: 忙碌的职场人士应在周末与家人共度高质量的时光。
entries.note: quality 前不加冠词；宾语为人，不能写成 spend quality time on sb。

entries.example: He has been estranged from his father for nearly a decade.
entries.exampleZh: 他与父亲疏远已近十年。
entries.note: 用 be estranged from sb；强调情感疏离，而非物理距离。

entries.example: Those who neglect their parents will regret it sooner or later.
entries.exampleZh: 忽视父母的人迟早会后悔。
entries.note: 及物动词直接接宾语；名词 negligence 指疏忽，多用于法律语境。

entries.example: The empty-nest elderly often suffer from loneliness and a sense of uselessness.
entries.exampleZh: 空巢老人常受孤独和无力感困扰。
entries.note: 定冠词 the 不可省；作主语时谓语动词用复数形式。

entries.example: Family ties remain strong even when members live in different cities.
entries.exampleZh: 即使家人分居不同城市，亲情纽带依然紧密。
entries.note: 惯用复数；常与 strengthen, maintain 搭配，多用于亲情纽带论证。

entries.example: Kinship is measured not by blood alone but by daily care.
entries.exampleZh: 亲情不只以血缘衡量，更以日常关爱衡量。
entries.note: 不可数；比 relationship 更文雅，适合开头点明主题。

entries.example: Parental love is usually unconditional and asks nothing in return.
entries.exampleZh: 父母之爱通常是无条件的，不求回报。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 give, offer 搭配；修饰 parental love 属高分表达。

entries.example: The bond between mother and child is one of the strongest in life.
entries.exampleZh: 母子之间的纽带是人生中最牢固的纽带之一。
entries.note: 可数；常与 strengthen, deepen, break 搭配，后接 between，用于情感类论证。

entries.example: We should cherish every moment we are able to spend with our loved ones.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应珍惜与所爱之人共度的每一刻。
entries.note: 及物；比 value 更富情感色彩，常用于结尾呼吁句。

entries.example: The values my parents taught me are the ones I hold dear.
entries.exampleZh: 父母教给我的价值观是我最珍视的。
entries.note: 宾语常为 values, memories, traditions；多用主动语态。

entries.example: The generation gap often gives rise to quarrels over marriage and career.
entries.exampleZh: 代沟常常在婚姻和职业问题上引发争吵。
entries.note: 常用 the generation gap；常与 bridge, narrow 搭配，作引言段点题词。

entries.example: Honest conversation can bridge the gap between parents and their children.
entries.exampleZh: 坦诚的交流能弥合父母与子女之间的隔阂。
entries.note: 后接 between A and B；也可用 narrow the gap 保持词汇变化。

entries.example: Mutual understanding begins with patient listening rather than hasty judgment.
entries.exampleZh: 相互理解始于耐心倾听，而非匆忙评判。
entries.note: 不可数；常与 promote, foster 搭配，适用于代际沟通主题。

entries.example: Only by putting ourselves in our parents' shoes can we grasp their worries.
entries.exampleZh: 只有设身处地为父母着想，我们才能理解他们的担忧。
entries.note: 变体为 put oneself in sb's position；常与 Only by 倒装连用，用于建议句。

entries.example: Reading together before bedtime has become a family tradition in our home.
entries.exampleZh: 睡前一起读书已成为我们家的家庭传统。
entries.note: 可数；常与 establish, pass on 搭配，与 family values 并列作论据。

entries.example: Strong family values are widely regarded as the bedrock of a healthy society.
entries.exampleZh: 牢固的家庭价值观被普遍视为健康社会的基石。
entries.note: 惯用复数，谓语用 are；常与 instil, uphold, pass on 搭配。

entries.example: A loving and disciplined upbringing shapes a child's character for life.
entries.exampleZh: 充满关爱又讲究规矩的教养会塑造孩子一生的性格。
entries.note: 常用单数；搭配 a strict, a sheltered upbringing，用于谈家教的影响。

entries.example: Parents should set an example for their children through their own conduct.
entries.exampleZh: 父母应以身作则，用自己的行为为孩子树立榜样。
entries.note: 介词用 for 或 to；也可说 lead by example 替换，避免重复。

entries.example: A father who reads every day is a role model for his son.
entries.exampleZh: 每天读书的父亲是儿子的榜样。
entries.note: 后接 for 或 to；role model 可数，前面必须加 a。

entries.example: Parents nurture their children with patience, warmth and quiet encouragement.
entries.exampleZh: 父母以耐心、温暖和无声的鼓励养育孩子。
entries.note: 比 raise 正式；也可搭配 nurture talent 或 nurture a habit，用于论证。

entries.example: Overprotection deprives children of the chance to solve problems themselves.
entries.exampleZh: 过度保护剥夺了孩子自己解决问题的机会。
entries.note: 不可数；动词为 overprotect；可替换 excessive care 保持变化。

entries.example: Parents who overindulge their children may raise adults who cannot cope.
entries.exampleZh: 过度溺爱孩子的父母可能养出无法应对生活的成年人。
entries.note: 及物动词；形容词 overindulgent 作定语修饰父母。

entries.example: Grandparents tend to spoil their grandchildren with toys and snacks.
entries.exampleZh: 祖父母往往用玩具和零食溺爱孙辈。
entries.note: 过去式与过去分词为 spoiled，英式亦作 spoilt。

entries.example: Doting parents often do everything for their children out of pure love.
entries.exampleZh: 宠爱孩子的父母常出于纯粹的爱替孩子包办一切。
entries.note: doting 只作定语，略带贬义；同结构可用 doting grandparents。

entries.example: Children raised as greenhouse flowers may collapse at the first setback.
entries.exampleZh: 被当作温室花朵养大的孩子可能一遇挫折就崩溃。
entries.note: 多含批评意味；常与 independence, setbacks 对照使用。

entries.example: Parents cannot shelter their children from every hardship in life.
entries.exampleZh: 父母无法保护孩子免受生活中的一切艰辛。
entries.note: 结构为 shelter sb from sth；也可用 protect sb from 替换，含反思意味。

entries.example: Cultivating independence matters far more than offering endless protection.
entries.exampleZh: 培养独立性远比给予无休止的保护更重要。
entries.note: 不可数；动词为 depend on；常与 foster, cultivate 搭配。

entries.example: Self-reliance is a lesson best learned in early childhood.
entries.exampleZh: 自立是最好在童年早期学会的一课。
entries.note: 不可数；比 independence 更强调靠自己，形容词为 self-reliant。

entries.example: Working mothers have to juggle work and family day after day.
entries.exampleZh: 职场母亲不得不日复一日地兼顾工作与家庭。
entries.note: 及物动词 juggle 后直接接两个宾语，也可接 a tight schedule。

entries.example: It is difficult but essential to strike a balance between career and family.
entries.exampleZh: 在事业与家庭之间取得平衡很难，却十分必要。
entries.note: 介词用 between；冠词 a 不可省，也可说 strike the right balance。

entries.example: Many parents sacrifice their own comfort for the sake of their children.
entries.exampleZh: 许多父母为了孩子牺牲自己的舒适生活。
entries.note: 结构 sacrifice sth for sth；名词搭配为 make sacrifices，用于感恩类段落。

entries.example: Parents should communicate with their children as friends rather than superiors.
entries.exampleZh: 父母应像朋友一样与孩子交流，而不是以长辈自居。
entries.note: 不及物动词加 with；名词搭配为 open, two-way communication。

entries.example: Teenagers often feel misunderstood by the very people who love them most.
entries.exampleZh: 青少年常常觉得自己被最爱自己的人误解。
entries.note: 过去分词 misunderstood 常作表语；名词 misunderstanding 可数。

entries.en: However busy we are, we should never ___.
entries.example: However busy we are, we should never neglect the people who love us.
entries.exampleZh: 无论多忙，我们都不该忽视那些爱我们的人。
entries.note: However 后紧跟形容词，从句不倒装；可换成 No matter how busy we are。

entries.en: It is never too late to ___.
entries.example: It is never too late to express our gratitude to our aging parents.
entries.exampleZh: 向年迈的父母表达感激，永远都不算晚。
entries.note: 结尾呼吁句常用；to 后接动词原形，泛指时主语可用 we 或 us。

entries.en: What our parents need is not ___ but ___.
entries.example: What our parents need is not money but our company and patience.
entries.exampleZh: 父母需要的不是金钱，而是我们的陪伴与耐心。
entries.note: 主语从句作主语谓语用单数 is；两个空缺处词性须一致。

entries.en: Only when we ___ can we truly understand our parents.
entries.zh: 只有当我们___，才能真正理解父母。
entries.example: Only when we become parents ourselves can we truly understand our parents.
entries.exampleZh: 只有当我们自己为人父母时，才能真正理解父母。
entries.note: Only when 置于句首时主句须部分倒装，用 can, do, will 等。

entries.example: Charity begins at home, so kindness should start with our own family.
entries.exampleZh: 仁爱始于家庭，所以善意应从自己的家人开始。
entries.note: 英语谚语，源自约翰·威克里夫；适用于家庭责任与孝道类主题。

entries.example: Blood is thicker than water, so family ties deserve our first loyalty.
entries.exampleZh: 血浓于水，所以亲情值得我们首先忠诚以待。
entries.note: 英语谚语；适用于亲情、家庭纽带类，可作段落中心句。

entries.en: We never know the love of a parent till we become parents ourselves.
entries.zh: 直到自己为人父母，我们才懂得父母之爱。
entries.example: We never know the love of a parent till we become parents ourselves.
entries.exampleZh: 直到自己为人父母，我们才懂得父母之爱。
entries.note: 出处：比彻（Henry Ward Beecher）；适用于代际理解与感恩类结尾。

entries.en: The family is the first essential cell of human society.
entries.zh: 家庭是人类社会第一个基本细胞。
entries.example: The family is the first essential cell of human society.
entries.exampleZh: 家庭是人类社会第一个基本细胞。
entries.note: 出处：教皇约翰二十三世；适用于家庭价值与社会和谐类主题段。
